# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite backend and memory-leak fixes** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backend bindings and fixes two native use-after-free leaks. Alongside the Skia m152 bump, this preview adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan/Metal/Dawn, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and fixes native use-after-free bugs in SKRegion and SKPixmap subsetting.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152** — The bundled engine is bumped to Chrome milestone m152, with follow-up merges of upstream m151/m152 stability fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds SkiaSharp bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, alongside a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and Vulkan test coverage on Android/Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works consistently across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **FreeType-based font support for Nano Server** — Nano Server now resolves fonts through FreeType instead of relying on unavailable platform font APIs. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes in SKRegion and SKPixmap** — Fixes a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, and a similar bug in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* by rooting the source pixel buffer. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on SKImage.Create failure** — Fixes a native memory leak that occurred when SKImage.Create's raster failure path left an allocated CoTaskMem pixel buffer undisposed. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **Containerized test legs and slnx solution format** — Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl and Nano Server containerized test coverage, and converts all .sln solutions to the newer .slnx format. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
- **Windows native build hardening** — Stops pinning a default Windows SDK version and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build instead of per invocation. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Faster and more deterministic binding generation** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check for lower per-call overhead, optimizes SKData.SaveTo to avoid a double buffer copy, and makes generated bindings deterministic across build platforms. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No functional HarfBuzzSharp binding changes; the touched files were solution-format conversion and CI test-leg infrastructure work.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 updated Skia to milestone m152, added Graphite GPU backend bindings and the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, introduced backend-neutral async pixel readback, and fixed use-after-free bugs in SKRegion and SKPixmap.
